title: Stage 06 Sample Answers
description: A complete correct sample and a one-misconception incorrect sample.

scenarioId.description: Scenario identifier copied from prior stages.

correct.description: Complete mathematically correct solution meeting all five essential criteria.

incorrect.description: Internally consistent solution with one clear concept-specific misconception.

text.description: Solution text with assessable steps separated by exactly two newline characters.

$comment: The correct sample must meet all five essential criteria and agree with the scenario, task, and rubric. The incorrect sample must contain exactly one misconception trajectory. Learner-facing text must contain no first person, em dash, correctness percentage, or diagnostic annotation.
